description: content_hash over a body carrying anchors, proving the field enters the JCS preimage exactly like any other producer-controlled field (RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.7, RFC-ACDP-0016 §5). The can-*-equivalent golden vector for this RFC.

vectors.name: Body with one macp.commitment anchor: canonicalization and SHA-256
vectors.description: Producer-supplied body fields including a single well-formed anchors entry. Apply JCS, then SHA-256, hex-encode lowercase. The anchor's own content_hash (sha256:fa8fe6b9...) is an opaque external-artifact digest, unrelated to the body's own content_hash being computed here.
implementer_notes: anchors sorts alphabetically before contributors in the JCS member ordering (RFC 8785 lexicographic key sort) — implementations sorting object keys by insertion order rather than by codepoint will diverge here.
The anchor's own content_hash is a nested value inside the body being hashed, not itself the hash target — do not confuse it with the outer sha256_hex being computed.
